narrative.overview: OmniBuf DevTools brings binary HTTP, ConnectRPC, and gRPC-Web inspection down to the calm clarity of Chrome DevTools' JSON Preview tab. Decoded fields read as clean key: value pairs at rest, free of competing wire-type pills, redundant hex conversions, or permanent byte-size columns. Wire-level details surface quietly on row hover, and the synchronized 16-byte Hex + ASCII inspector stays tucked inside an optional side panel until toggled open.
keyCharacteristics: Calm 2-pane default split (Requests rail on the left, Tree | JSON | Headers stage on the right) with an on-demand Hex side panel.
Clean key: value field tree with progressive hover disclosure for wire numbers, wire types, byte sizes, and raw hex slices.
Dual-voice IBM Plex typography: geometric sans chrome framing tabular monospace paths, trees, and byte grids.
Restrained neutral hierarchy that suppresses healthy 200 badges, bordered uppercase pills, and stacked toolbars.
Adaptive layout scaling from a 2/3-pane desktop split down to a single-bar Master-Detail mobile inspector with 8-byte hex rows.

rules.name: The Dark-Ink Accent Rule
rules.body: Solid Signal Orange fills always pair with Carbon Ink (#111111) text, never white text.

rules.name: The Quiet Default Rule
rules.body: Healthy HTTP 200 responses, resting field wire types, and resting byte sizes remain unbadged and hidden until needed; reserve color badges for HTTP/RPC errors (>= 400) and active Hex byte-slice inspection.

rules.name: The Tabular Byte Rule
rules.body: Every element displaying counts, status codes, hover byte lengths, or hexadecimal offsets applies font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Offline Font Rule
rules.body: Extension bundles ship local WOFF2 subsets inside dist/fonts/ with zero external network requests.

dos: Do keep resting field-tree rows focused on key: value legibility and reveal wire metadata on hover or inside the optional Hex panel.
Do keep the Hex panel closed by default so primary tree and JSON inspection gets full horizontal breathing room.
Do keep secondary settings tucked inside the overflow menu.
donts: Don't render green 200 pills, uppercase protocol badges, or inline hex conversions on resting list or tree rows.
Don't stack multiple toolbars above the response tree.
Don't load fonts, icons, or stylesheets from external URLs.
Don't auto-decode untagged application/proto or application/octet-stream responses without explicit confirmation.
